description: Opt-in supply-chain hardening module. Extend it LAST, after the base or */default presets it hardens: it only appends packageRules and vulnerabilityAlerts settings and does not extend any other preset.

packageRules.description: Never automerge GitHub Actions, Gradle wrapper or custom regex tool pins: they execute in CI and build environments, so every update waits for a human review after the stability gate
Never automerge container images (Dockerfile and docker-compose base images, CI service and job images): they execute as the runtime of the build or service
Never automerge Gradle plugins: they run inside the build with full access to sources and credentials
Never automerge Maven build plugins and extensions: they run inside the build with full access to sources and credentials
Keep lock-file maintenance as a reviewed PR: it refreshes transitive versions that no minimumReleaseAge gate covers, because those updates carry no release timestamp
